title.en: Set Patch orchestration options to Azure-orchestrated

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachineScaleSets. Specific focus: Azure guest orchestration.

title.en: Configure continuous backup mode

summary.en: Cosmos DB's backup is always on, offering protection against data mishaps. Continuous mode allows for self-serve restoration to a pre-mishap point, unlike periodic mode which requires contacting Microsoft support, leading to longer restore times.

applicability.en: Source resource or workload: Microsoft.DocumentDB/databaseAccounts. Specific focus: Cosmos continuous backup.
Identify the exact supported data or configuration objects, consistency requirements, retention, recovery location and encryption-key dependencies.

applicability.en: Cosmos DB regional, write and consistency settings interact with SDK routing. Continuous backup and multi-region replication are separate protection mechanisms.

title.en: Ensure both connections of an ExpressRoute are configured in active-active mode

summary.en: Alert when the cluster size reaches 14 hosts. Set up periodic alerts for planning new clusters or datastores due to growth, especially from storage needs. Beyond 14 hosts, trigger alerts for each new host addition for proactive resource monitoring.

Review which zone settings are creation-time only. Plan a supported migration if the current resource cannot be changed in place, then distribute workload and state according to the service's model.
implementation_steps.ko: 생성할 때만 지정할 수 있는 영역 설정을 확인합니다. 기존 리소스를 직접 변경할 수 없다면 지원되는 이전 방식을 계획한 뒤 서비스 구조에 맞게 워크로드와 데이터를 분산합니다.

implementation_steps.en: Review the pinned APRL action 'Use Azure Disks with Zone Redundant Storage for higher resiliency and availability' against the original description and cited documentation. Prepare a supported, scoped change proposal and rollback; this guide itself does not execute or approve changes.
Prepare independent observations for: Disk redundancy SKU, regional ZRS support and the independent VM recovery procedure. Resolve unsupported or ambiguous conditions before proposing a change.

verification_steps.en: Inspect and retain source-attributed configuration or workload evidence for: Disk redundancy SKU, regional ZRS support and the independent VM recovery procedure.
Use a separately authorized failure exercise or existing failover evidence to verify application requests and state access when a zone is unavailable; measure remaining capacity and reconnect time.
verification_steps.ko: 별도로 승인된 장애 시험이나 기존 장애 조치 기록으로 한 영역을 사용할 수 없을 때 요청 처리와 데이터 접근을 검증합니다. 남는 용량과 재연결 시간을 측정합니다.

verification_steps.en: Compare the observed Zone-redundant disks behavior with this recommendation's intended mechanism and the original source. Record timestamps, scope, missing coverage and conflicting observations.
Keep the existing automated, manual, blocked or unsupported assessment disposition separate. Missing evidence stays unknown; a diagram, a setting write or API acceptance is not operational success.
verification_steps.ko: 기존의 자동, 수동, blocked 또는 미지원 평가 상태를 별도로 유지합니다. 정보가 없으면 알 수 없음으로 남깁니다. 그림, 설정 쓰기나 API 수락은 운영 성공이 아닙니다.

cautions.en: Zone redundancy is not cross-region disaster recovery and does not provide point-in-time recovery from corruption or deletion.
cautions.ko: 영역 중복은 지역 간 재해 복구가 아니며, 데이터 손상이나 삭제 이전 시점으로 복구하는 기능도 아닙니다.

cautions.en: The pinned APRL description and benefits are English-source metadata with explicit English fallback, not an independently verified Korean translation. Current product support must be checked before use.
cautions.ko: 고정된 APRL 설명과 기대 효과는 영어 대체 표시를 사용하는 원본 메타데이터이며 검증된 한국어 번역이 아닙니다. 사용 전에 현재 제품 지원을 확인해야 합니다.

cautions.en: Compute placement, guest readiness, disk durability and quota are distinct. A replicated disk or supported VM SKU does not automatically recover a running application.
cautions.ko: 컴퓨팅 배치, 게스트 준비, 디스크 내구성과 할당량은 별개입니다. 복제 디스크나 지원 VM SKU가 실행 중인 애플리케이션을 자동으로 복구하지는 않습니다.

title.en: Zone-redundant disks: configuration concept

description.en: Repository-authored conceptual diagram, not an observed deployment or assessment result. Availability zones separate datacenter failure domains inside one region. Resilience depends on the selected service's actual zone behavior and on compute, state and routing surviving the same failure; a zone label alone does not establish application availability.
description.ko: 실제 배포나 평가 결과가 아닌 저장소 작성 개념도입니다. 가용성 영역은 한 지역 안의 데이터센터 장애 범위를 분리합니다. 서비스의 실제 영역 지원 방식과 컴퓨팅, 데이터, 라우팅을 함께 확인해야 합니다. 영역이 지정되어 있다는 사실만으로 애플리케이션 가용성을 판단할 수는 없습니다.
